description: Immediately after any outreach message is confirmed sent, update the contact's people file (last_contact, follow_up, conversation_history, commitments_made) and commit it to git. If session dies after HOW.py succeeds, state is preserved. If session dies before HOW.py runs, git status surfaces uncommitted changes on resume.
litmus: Run HOW.py with people_file + career_home + updates + commit_message — exit 0=committed, exit 1=BLOCK (validation failed), exit 2=WARN (file written but commit failed).

files.HOW.py: Enforcement gate — update people file fields and commit atomically after outreach send
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detects uncommitted writes and validation failures in enforcement log
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signals session_death_risk if commit-after-write failures are high

origin_incident: 2026-05-04: outreach was sent to contacts without updating their people files, creating stale state that caused duplicate outreach suggestions in the same session.
